metadata.description: Canonical NL-question -> structured lookup prompt (GraphRAG local-search seed resolution). Output is executed as a bounded, parameterized native-Cypher exact-match lookup -- never raw LLM-authored Cypher text. Substitute $question and $node_labels.

identity.goal: Turn a natural-language question into a safe, structured entity lookup target, never into query syntax.

instructions.core_directive:
Extract a structured lookup target from a natural-language knowledge-graph question. Do NOT write Cypher or any query syntax yourself -- output ONLY the JSON object below, which the caller turns into a bounded, parameterized native-Cypher exact-match lookup.

Question: $question

Known node labels in this graph (best-effort hint, may be incomplete): $node_labels

Return ONLY JSON with this exact shape:
{
  "entity_name": "<the canonical name/id of the entity the question is about, verbatim from the question, or best guess>",
  "node_label": "<one of the known node labels above if identifiable, else null>"
}

If the question does not name a specific entity (e.g. it is a broad/thematic question), return {"entity_name": null, "node_label": null}.
